contexts.text: The hand upon the wall () = Own power, and trust in sensuous things, and the consequent blinding, which is described.
He put forth his hand () = his Own power... The hand = power; thus, here, Own power from which he [acted].
That by the hand is signified power, also Power, and the derivative confidence. Illustrated.
The hand = Own power. AC 878. AC 878:2.
Short in hand () = of no power.
He hath no hands () = that he has no power.
As the hands = powers, the evils and falsities of man in the Word passim are called the works of their hands.
As the hands = in general, power, hands are frequently attributed to Jehovah... and there by hands... is meant Omnipotence. Illustrated.

That by the hand is signified power, is now manifestly evident; nay, so much did the hand = power, that it became also a representative, as is evident from the miracles which were done in Egypt. Illustrated... No one... can believe that there was anything of power in the hand or rod of Moses; but because the uplifting and outstretching of the hand signified Divine power, it was made a representative in the Jewish Church. Illustrated.
In like manner, that hands were laid on them when they were consecrated. Illustrated... Thence comes the rite at the present day of inaugurating and blessing by means of the laying on of hands.

That the hand signifies and represents power, may be evident from the representatives in the World of Spirits. There, a certain naked arm sometimes comes into view, in which there is such strength, that it can break the bones to pieces, and bruise the inmost marrows as it were into nothing; and there is such terror from it that they melt away at heart; nay, there actually is such strength in it.
Into your hands let them be given () = a possession of the internal man with the external.
The hand () = the will, because it = power; for power is of the will.
The hand, in the Word, = power; the arm, power still greater; and the shoulder, all power.
Your hands have made them () = that they are from proprium.
Man is not therefore to hang down his hands. SE 2732.

I have elevated my hand to Jehovah () = the mind such as it was with the Lord... The elevation of the hand to Jehovah is a gesture of the body which corresponds to the affection of the mind... Here, therefore, the elevation of the hand = the mind, or the affection of the mind.
Under Heat, see this reference.
Thy hand-maid is in thy hand () = that this Rational was conceived under the Power of the affection of truth adjoined to good. The hand = Power.
Humble thyself under her hands () = that it ought to compel itself to be under its Power.
His hand shall be against all () = that he will fight against those things which are not truths; and the hand of all shall be against him = that falsities will fight back.
In the Word... power and strength are expressed and signified by the hand, and the arm.
Broken in feet and hands () = those who are in perverted external worship.
To take a handful represented that they were to love with all their forces, or with all the soul; for the hand, or the palm, = power.
The men put forth their hand () = the Lord's powerful aid... The hand = power.

The men took hold of his hand, and of the hand of his wife, and of the hand of his two daughters () = that the Lord powerfully withheld from evils, and thus strengthened the goods and truths... The hand = power.
In the blamelessness of my hands have I done this () = from the affection of truth, and thus from every faculty... The hands are predicated of truth, and = power, thus faculty.
Strengthen thy hand in him () = support thence... The hand = power, which is of support.
Besides representatives, there are also correspondences... as that... the hands correspond to power.
Abraham sent forth his hand () = temptation even to the last of power... The hand = power; here, the last of power, because nothing but the act was wanting.
To place the hand in the sea, and the right hand in the rivers () = that strength is in the knowledges and in the Knowledges of truth. The hand, and the right hand, = strength.
They believe that thus... they would have to hang down their hands. AC 5660:2. SE 2732. SE 3518.
Place thy hand under my thigh () = the binding thereof as to power to the good of conjugial love. The hand = power... or as much as one is able.
All the good of his lord in his hand () = their goods and truths with him... The hand = power; thus, the things with him.
She let down her jar upon her hand () = the submission of the recipients from power... The hand = power.
Power is especially attributed in the Word to truth; and therefore the hands, arms, and shoulders are predicated of truth... Power itself is from good through truth, and appears to be from truth.
The bracelets were placed on the hands of the bride, because by the bride was signified the Church, and by her hands, powers from truth. The hands are predicated of truth.
Upon her hands () = the power of the affection of truth. The hand = power.
When he saw the pendant and the bracelets on the hands of his sister () = when he apperceived Divine good and Divine truth in the power of the affection of truth... The hands = power.
His hand taking hold on the heel of Esau () = the lowest of natural good to which it adhered with some power. The hand = power.
Upon his hands () = according to the faculty of receiving. The hand = power, thus the faculty of receiving.

The voice is the voice of Jacob, and the hands are the hands of Esau () = that the Intellectual is of truth, which is within; but the Voluntary is of good, which is without... Voice is predicated of truth; and hand, of good... The reason hand is predicated of good, is that by the hand is signified power and faculty; which is from no other source than good; all the power and faculty in truth is thence...
He gave into the hand of his sons () = that those things were given to truths... To give into their hands = to their jurisdiction and disposal; for by the hand is signified power. AC 4013.
Be my hand to God to do with you evil () = a state of indignation if he had the power. The hand = power.
Of my hand hast thou required it () = that it was from Himself. The hand = power, thus that it was from Himself; for what is from His power is from Himself.
To give into the hand () = to instruct with power, The hand = power.
A hand for God = that there may be power. Illustrated... The hand = power; and the hand is predicated of truth.
Which were in their hand () = as much as possible; for the hand = power. Hence what is in the hand = what is in the power, or as much as possible.
Let not our hand pe upon him () = that they may be without blame.
Thy staff which is in thy hand () = by the power of that truth... The hand, also, = power.
As the hand is the principal by which power is signified, and a staff is the instrumental, therefore miracles were done when the hand was stretched out. Illustrated.
The hand which it enters and pierces () = power from the Word.
He gave his hand () = power.
As he drew back his hand () = that he concealed his power.
On the correspondence of the hands, arms, etc., with the Grand Man. General article.

They who in the Grand Man correspond to the hands and arms, and also to the shoulders, are they who are in power through the truth of faith from good; for they who are in the truth of faith from good are in the Lord's power; for they attribute all power to Him, and none to themselves...

The reason why the hands, arms, and shoulders correspond to power in the Grand Man, is that the forces and powers of the whole body and of all its viscera have reference to them; for the body exercises its forces and powers through the arms and hands. Hence it is that in the Word by the hands, the arms, and the shoulders are signified powers. Illustrated.

Whatever he had, he gave into his hand () = that all belonging to him was as it were in his Power. The hand = power. References. Thus to give into his hand = into his Power; but as this is done apparently, it is said as it were into his Power. AC 4983. AC 4993. AC 5008. AC 5045.
The hand = power, or Power. References.
Pharaoh's cup was in my hand () = the influx of the interior Natural into the exterior, and the beginning of reception... In my hand = with him.

Under the hand of Pharaoh () = for necessity and consequent disposal in the Natural. The hand = power; therefore,under the hand = for disposal in every necessity; for what is in the power of anyone, is at his disposal.
Pharaoh removed his ring from upon his hand () = a Confirmative concerning the power which it had before... The hand = power.
And gave it upon Joseph's hand () = that it ceded it all to the Celestial of the Spiritual. To give a ring upon the hand of another = a Confirmative that one cedes to another the power one has.

Without thee there shall not a man lift up his hand () = that from the Celestial of the Spiritual is all the power in the Spiritual. The hand = power... That power in the Spiritual is signified by the hand, will be seen in what follows.
To lift up the hand = power in the Spiritual; and to lift up the foot, power in the Natural; for the things in the body which are above the feet, relate to spiritual things.
Therefore the power which is signified by the hand, is predicated of the Spiritual; namely, of truth from good. References.

Give him upon my hand () = as much as was in his power. The hand = power. To give him upon his hand, in the proper sense, = to trust him to him; but as faith in the understanding... has but little power to be trusted in... therefore, Give him upon my hand = as much as was in his power.
He stretched out his hand in order to exercise imaginary power.
Out of my hand thou shalt seek him () = that he shall not be forced away so far as it was in his power. The hand = power.

Take double silver in your hands () = truth received in the powers... The hands = powers... Truth in the powers is truth in the faculties of receiving, thus according to the faculties; but the faculties or powers of receiving truth are altogether according to good. Explained.
They brought him the present which was in their hand to the house () = insinuation as much as possible... Which was in their hand = as much as possible.
Put thy hand under my thigh () = a holy binding... The hand = power.
He took hold of the hand of his father () = influx into the power of his obscure apperception... The hand = power.
The arms of his hands are strengthened () = the power of the forces of fighting. Arms, and hands, = powers... (here) of fighting, because it treats of combat.
By the hands of the powerful Jacob () = by the Omnipotence of the Lord's Divine Human. The hands = power; and, in the supreme sense, in which the Lord is treated of, Omnipotence. References.
To deliver out of the hand of the shepherds () = that he prevailed over the power of falsity from evil... The hand = power.
I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians () = that He let Himself down to them to take them out of the power of the false scientifics... The hand = power.

And not with a mighty hand () = that the power of those who are of the Spiritual Church will not prevail against them. The hand = power; therefore, not with a mighty hand = the power which will not prevail.
I will send My hand () = power from the Divine. The hand = power.
What is that in thy hand? And he said, A staff () = the power of the Lord's Divine Human. The hand = power.

The power which is signified by the hand, is the power proceeding from the Lord's Divine Rational; but the power which is signified by the staff, is the power proceeding from the Lord's Divine Natural... For a staff, like a foot, supports the body; and by the foot is signified the Natural. To lift up the hand = power in the Spiritual; and to lift up the foot = power in the Natural; and because it is so, according to the elevations of the things in the internal sense, it is sometimes said to Moses, when he was to do miracles, that he should lift up the hand; and sometimes, that he should lift up the staff.
Put forth thy hand, and take hold of its tail () = the power of elevating from the ultimate of the Sensuous. The hand = power.
Put thine hand into thy bosom () = the appropriation of truth. The hand = power.
His hand was leprous as snow () = the profanation of truth. The hand = power; and truth, because spiritual power consists in truth.

Thou shalt take this staff in thine hand () = Divine power in them... By the hand is signified spiritual power; and by the staff, natural power. As there is nothing of power in the Natural except from the Spiritual, so there is not in a staff unless it is in the hand; and therefore it is said that he should take it into his hand. The hand, when predicated of the Lord, = the power proceeding from His Divine Rational; and the staff, power proceeding from His Divine Natural.
See all the portents which I have put in thine hand () = the means of power from the Spiritual then... The hand = spiritual power.
Because with a strong hand he shall let them go () = that with all force and power they will flee from them. A strong hand = all force and power. The hand = power.
I will bring you to the Land as to which I did lift up my hand... () = elevation to Heaven from Divine power... To lift up the hand, when said of Jehovah, = from Divine power. The hand = power.
I will send my hand upon the Egyptians () = that therefore they shall be compelled by Divine power. The hand = power; and when Jehovah speaks of Himself, and says His hand, it = Divine power.
In stretching out My hand upon the Egyptians () = when they observe the Divine power in themselves. The hand, when said of the Divine, = Divine power.
The hand () = power, but spiritual power, from which is the natural power which is the staff.
To take a staff and stretch out the hand () = to exercise spiritual power through the Natural.

Stretch out thine hand with thy staff () = the power of internal truth through external truth. The hand = spiritual power, which is of internal truth; and a staff = natural power, which is of external truth. AC 7385.
Wash... also my hands and my head ()... By the hands are signified the interiors of the Natural.
The hand of Jehovah being upon anyone = a plague or punishment; for the hand = power; and the hand of Jehovah, Omnipotence.

I might put forth my hand () = that the communication might be taken away. The hand = power; the hand of Jehovah, Omnipotence; therefore to put forth the hand = to show power; and, from Omnipotence, to do it.
Stretch out thine hand towards heaven () = the advertence and approach of Heaven. To stretch out the hand = to advert to...

By the hand of Moses () = by the medium of the law from the Divine. By the hand of anyone = mediately... The reason to speak by the hand of anyone = by his means, or mediately, is that by the hand is signified power; thus, by the hand of anyone, vicarious power, which is the same as mediately; for what is done mediately, is done through the power of another in one's self. Illustrated.
I saw a certain hand, which did not hold this flaming object, but to which it adhered; at first on the back, afterwards on the palm; and thence it played round the hand...
The hand, to which the flaming object adhered, = life and its power.
Their celestial love... was signified by the flaming object which adhered to the hand.

Stretch out thine hand () = the dominion of power... because power is in the hand or arm when it is stretched out. Therefore, when it is said of Jehovah, that He stretches out His hand, or His arm, there is signified unlimited or infinite power in act. Illustrated. AC 7710.
To give into the hand () = to leave; for by the hand is signified power; therefore by to give into the hand, is signified to deliver into their power, thus to leave.
The lintel and the posts = the same as the forehead and the hands with man. AC 7847:2, Illustrated.
Your staff in your hand () = as to the means. Explained.

It shall be to thee for a sign upon thine hand () = that it shall be perpetually in the will... The hand = power; here, the will; because all action and power of action which is done by the hand, proceeds from the will. AC 8090.
The strong hand of Jehovah () = the Divine power of the Lord. AC 8084.

The sons of Israel went forth with a high hand () = when yet, by the Divine power, they were free from their endeavour to subjugate them... A high hand = Divine power; for by the hand is signified power; and by high, what is Divine.
Stretch out thine hand upon the sea () = the dominion of power where is the Hell of falsity from evil. To stretch out the hand = the dominion of power. AC 8222.
To save from their hand () = to be protected from the violence of those who are in falsities from evil.
Israel saw the great hand which Jehovah did upon the Egyptians () = the acknowledgement of the Omnipotence of the Lord... A hand, great, strong, robust, high, when said of Jehovah, = Omnipotence.
My hand shall drive them out () = that from power Heaven will be destroyed... The hand = power.

Thy hands, Lord, have prepared a sanctuary () = Heaven, where are those who are in the truth of faith from the Lord... Thy hands have prepared = that it is from the Lord. The reason it is said of the sanctuary, that hands have prepared it, is that hands are said of truth; and = power.

That they who are in the truth and good of faith conquer when they look upwards to the Lord, and that they yield when they look downwards, is represented by the sons of Israel conquering when Moses kept his hands raised, and by their yielding when he let them down. AC 8604. AC 8606.

The staff of God in my hand () = that there is power thence... By a staff is signified exterior power; and by the hand, interior power; or, by a staff, natural power; and by the hand, spiritual power.
The hands of Moses were heavy () = that the power of looking upwards to the Lord was deficient. The hands = the powers which are of faith.
His hands were firm () = the strength of power then. The hands = power.
Because the hand is against the throne of Jah () = because they want to do violence to the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom.
The likeness of the hands of a man under their wings () = the Omnipotence possessed by Divine truth; because the hands = power; and, in the supreme sense. Omnipotence, when attributed to the Lord.
A hand shall not touch it () = that those who by any self-confidence infuse themselves... A hand = power; hence, also, self-confidence.

The concupiscence of falsity is meant by the right hand scandalizing ()... For the hand corresponds to the power which is of truth; the right hand, to the power of truth from good; in the opposite sense, to the power of falsity from evil.

Found in his hand () = still the acknowledgement of the truth of faith. To be found in the hand, when said of the truth of faith, = acknowledgement; for when it is acknowledged with some faith it is found with him. In his hand = with him.

If he dies under his hand () = so that it is extinguished under his view... Under his hand = under the view; for the hand = the power which is of spiritual truth; thus which is of the view; for the view is effected from that truth, and is apperception...

A hand for a hand () = if anything of the power of spiritual truth (was injured by them). The hand = the power which is from truth. References. And that it = the power from spiritual truth. References.

If in finding there be found the theft in his hand () = if there pe any residue of truth and good through which restoration may be made... In his hand = in his power... In his hand = also what is with him... because by the hand is signified power; and whatever is in anyone's power is with him. Hence, also, by the hand, and especially by the right hand, is signified [the man] himself. From this it may be evident what is signified by to sit at the right hand of the Father... that it = to be everything with the Father; thus to be Himself.

Whether he hath put his hand to the work of his companion () = whether he has entered into it; (for) whether he hath put his hand = whether he has made good of his own jurisdiction and power... The hand = power. That which is in the hand = that which is with anyone, and in anyone.

Thou shalt not put thine hand with the wicked () = no obedience to malignities. To put the hand = obedience; for by the hand is signified power; and also, what is with anyone; thus one's self so far as one is able. References. Therefore, to put the hand with anyone = to make one with him; which, when it is done from malignity... = to obey; for malignity persuades and leads.
I will give into your hand the inhabitants of the land () = command over evils. To give into the hand = to conquer and command.
He sent not his hand () = that truth is not there in its power. The hand = the power which is through truth... All the power of truth is from good; thus through good from the Lord.
Two hands [tenons] shall be to one board () = the power thence; namely, through truth from good. The hand = power... and all power is through truth from good.
The work of their hands = from Own intelligence.
Hence it is that the hands and arms, and also the soles and feet, correspond to the ultimates of Heaven. In ultimates consists power...

Thou shalt fill their hand () = a representative of the Lord as to the truth of faith. To fill the hand of Aaron and his sons = to inaugurate to represent the Lord as to the Divine truth which is of faith; for by the hand is signified the power which is of truth from good; and therefore the hand is predicated of truth. References.

Thou shalt fill the hand of Aaron, and the hand of his sons () = inauguration to represent the Divine power of the Lord through Divine truth from Divine good... There were two things by which the inauguration into the priesthood took place: anointing, and the filling of the hand... and by the filling of the hand there took place inauguration to represent the Lord as to the Divine truth from Divine good, and thus power; for by the hand is signified power; and the hand is predicated of the truth which is from good; because all power is of truth from good... And as the head and the whole body exercise their power through the hands; and power is what is active of life with man, therefore by the hand is also signified whatever is with man, thus the man himself in so far as he is acting; from which it may be evident what is signified by to to fill the hand.
The process of the filling of the hand. Described.

Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock () = a representative of the reception of good and truth in the natural man. To lay on the hands = to communicate what is one's own to another. The reason it also = reception, is that what is communicated is received by the other... The reason to lay on the hand = communication and reception, is that the hand = power, which, being what is active of life, by the hands is also signified whatever is with a man, thus the whole man in so far as he is acting... Hence it is evident what was signified by the laying on of hands with the Ancients; namely, the communication and transference of that thing which is being treated of, and also the reception by the other; whether that thing be power, obedience, blessing, or testification.
That by the laying on of hands is signified power. Illustrated.
To lay on the hand, here, = the communication and transference of the power which Moses had, and its reception by Joshua.

That the sons of Israel laid their hands upon the Levites, signified the transference of the power of ministering for them, and its reception by the Levites, thus separation. And that the Levites laid their hands upon the head of the bullocks, signified the transference of that power to Jehovah... Therefore it is said that thus they were separated from the midst of the sons of Israel, and were for Jehovah.

The laying of the hands upon the he-goat, signified the communication and transference of all the iniquities and sins of the sons of Israel, and the reception of them by the he-goat. Further illustrated.

The reason such things are signified by the contact which is effected by means of the hands, derives its origin from the representatives in the other life... Those there who mutually touch each other, communicate the state of their life to the other; if this is done by means of the hands, the whole of the life is communicated; because by the hands... from the correspondence, there is signified power, which is what is active of the life; thus there is signified whatever is with him.

The reason the touch of the hand also communication, transference, and reception, is that the activity of the whole body is collected into the arms and hands... Hence it is that the arms, the hands, and especially the right hand = power... and hence the hands = whatever is with a man, thus the whole man in so far as he is acting.
For the horns of the altar relate to the arms and hands with man, by which is also signified truth in its power in the ultimates. References.

His hands and his feet () = the interiors and exteriors of man... The reason the hands = the interiors, is that the higher things of the body extend themselves into the hands, and are there terminated. Hence the hands = whatever is with man; and also his power. But when both the hands and the feet are mentioned, there is signified whatever is in the internal and also in the external man, or spiritual and natural things. Hence it is, that to lift up the hand = power in the Spiritual; and to lift up the foot, power in the Natural. Moreover, by the extremes of man are signified all things of him; and the extremes are the hands and feet.

He took them out of their hand () = things favouring their proprium; (for) to take out of the hand of anyone = to take such things as are his, thus which are of proprium, or which favour proprium; for by the hand is signified the power or ability of man; and thence whatever is of him.
The work of the hands = what is from the proprium of man...
With great power, and with a strong hand () = from Divine power.

Fill ye your hand today to Jehovah () = what is communicative and receptive of Divine truth in the Heavens. To fill the hand to Jehovah = a representative of the Divine power of the Lord in the Heavens through the Divine truth proceeding from His Divine good; and what is communicative and receptive thereof there; here, what is communicative of Divine truth with the Heavens by representatives...
The two tables of the testimony were in the hand of Moses () = a representative of the Word... In the hand of Moses = a representative of it; namely, of the Word.
The Ultimate... Heaven forms... also the arms down to the fingers; for the arms and hands are ultimates of man, although at the side.
They who are in the arms and hands are in the power of truth from good.
Hence... by the arms, and the hands, is signified the power of truth.
Hence the created universe is the work of the hands of Jehovah... that is, the work of the Divine love and the Divine wisdom; for these are meant by the hands of Jehovah.

As the whole, or the body, has determined its powers chiefly into the arms and hands, which are ultimates, therefore by the arms and hands, in the Word, is signified power; and by the right hand, higher power. As the evolution and putting forth of the degrees into power is of this kind, therefore from the action alone which is made with the hands, the Angels who are with the man, and in the correspondence of all things belonging to him, know his quality as to understanding and will, and also as to charity and faith, and thus as to the internal life of his mind, and as to the external life which is derived from it in the body. I have often wondered that the Angels have such Knowledge from the mere action of the body through the hands; but it has sometimes been shown by living experience; and I have been told that it is from this that inaugurations into the ministry are performed by the laying on of hands; and that to touch with the hand = to communicate; besides other like things.
To wash the head and the hands () = to purify the internal man; and to wash the feet = to purify the external man.

He placed His right hand upon me () = life then inspired by Him. The reason the Lord placed His right hand upon him, is that communication is effected by the touch of the hands. The reason is that the life of the mind and thence of the body puts itself forth into the arms, and through them into the hands. It is from this that the Lord resuscitated to life and healed by the touch of the hand. Illustrated. AE 79.

They did not perform repentance from the works of their hands () = that neither did they shun their Own things... as sins. The reason why by the works of a man's hands are signified the man's Own things... is that by the hands are signified in sum the things which proceed from the man; for the forces of his mind and of his body thence are determined into the hands, and are there terminated; and therefore by the hands, in the Word, is signified power.

By the works of man's hands, in the natural sense, are meant graven images, etc.; but in the spiritual sense, by them are signified evils and falsities of every kind, which are the things proper to man. Illustrated.

The two hands are ultimates of man. Are there not interior things which are continued thither? They are from the head through the neck, also through the breast, shoulders, arms, and forearms; and there are the innumerable muscular textures... fibres... nerves and blood-vessels, and the many connections of the bones with their membranes and ligaments. Does man know anything concerning these? and yet his hands operate from all these things.
To lift up his hand unto heaven () = attestation. AE 607.

To receive the mark upon the forehead and upon the hand () = to receive it in love and faith, and to confirm one's self in it; and as they who confirm themselves in this love and faith also live according to it, this also is meant. AE 886.
They folded their hands, and whispered votive praise...
Then we stretched out our hands, and lo! the (serpents invaded the city).
From her application, which is to such things as are works of the hands...

It was said to me from Heaven, Examine these three universals... and afterwards we shall see them in your hand. It was said in the hand, because all things which a man examines with the understanding, appear to the Angels as if written on his hands.

He who knows the influx of successive order into what is simultaneous, may comprehend the reason why the Angels can see in the hand of a man all the thoughts and intentions of his mind: and also, why wives, from the hands of their husbands upon their own bosoms, feel their affections... The reason is, that the hands are ultimates of man, into which are determined the cogitations and conclusions of his mind, and there make what is simultaneous; and therefore it is said in the Word that it is written on the hands.

The reason communications of the mind are effected through (the sense of touch), is that the hands are ultimates of man, and his primes are in the ultimates simultaneously... Hence it is that Jesus touched little children... and that He healed the sick by the touch; and that they were healed who touched Him. Hence, too, it is, that inaugurations into the priesthood at this day are effected by means of the laying on of hands...

I said, Beware, perhaps a hand may appear from Heaven, which... strikes an incredible terror... and which has been to me a confirmation that the right hand of God = Omnipotence. Scarcely was this said, when a hand was seen stretched out under Heaven...

a. His hands appeared to be loose from his body; first his left hand... He complained that he had lost his hand. After some time, his right hand, in like manner. I was told that if he did not receive his hands... he would still trust in his own power...

One said that this is not a phantasy, because he feels his hand touching it... But his hand can be taken away from him, and a new one can be in its place; nay, many hands can be added to him, and he know no otherwise.
They led my hand to write thus.
They were not permitted to touch others through my hands.
On a certain one who touched my hands.

On folding my hands with a certain person, I perceived that as it were it was not I who folded them, but another. There was a certain one who said that he felt exactly as if he were folding the hands, in my place; so that... he then possessed my hand with its touch.
It was given to liken them to his arms or hands...
Ratiocinators are the arms and hands of evil Spirits...
I perceived... that they thought themselves to be altogether in the world... I touched their hands in that state... But they were grievously punished...

When I was writing... every word and syllable... was perceived by the celestials, and as it were spoke to them. This is effected by the affection in which the man is being communicated to the hand, or being in the hand; for the hand, being power, is the man himself. Hence it is evident in what manner the Word was inspired... Hence it is, that, in writing, the hand was circumstanced according to the affection... and the obscurity with me.

The book was instantly taken away by another upon a mountain... They said that this is done by putting one's self in the state of another... and that when this is done they merely stretch out the hand, which is the sign.
At last there appeared as it were a hand stretched out by the Lord, over the Heavens, and then commenced the combat... between Michael and the dragon.
That in the touch of the hand there is affection from thought.

It has been made known to me by living experience that in the touch of the hand there is affection with thought. I touched an Angel with my hand; and the Angel said that from the mere touch he felt my affection with my thought. Hence it is evident whence it is that they are in works in the Spiritual World; because the thought is determined... through the hand into works; and why the Lord touched many; and also why, by means of the touch of the hands upon the head, inaugurations take place into the priesthood.

To have in His right hand () = from Himself; for the hand = power; and thence whatever is with him; thus, also, whatever is from Him. The reason the right hand is mentioned, is that the right hand = the power of good through truth.

The reason to touch with the hand = to communicate and to transfer into the other, is that all the power of the man is transferred from the body into the hands; and therefore what the mind wills that the body should do, the arms and the hands do. Hence it is that the arms, and the hands, in the Word, = power. References. But this power is natural power... Spiritual power is to will the good of another, and to will to convey to another as far as possible what belongs to one's self. This power is what is signified by the hand in the spiritual sense; and its communication and transference are signified by to touch with the hand. Illustrated.

Because to touch, and to lay on hands = to communicate and transfer into another what appertains to one's self, it has been customary in the Churches from ancient times to lay hands upon the head of those who are being inaugurated and blessed. Illustrated.
The likeness of hands under the wings = the power of Divine truth.
The right hand, and the right foot = intelligence and the power of truth from good in the internal and in the external man.
The works of the hands = the things which are from Own intelligence. AE 355:29.
The hands, and the fingers = power, and thence all things with them which they are able for.
Clean in hands () = those who are in truths from faith.
The labour of the hands = the study of life.
The deed of His hands is said of the truths of doctrine.

That they should bind them upon their hands represented ultimates; because the hands are the ultimates of the forces of man's soul; thus upon the forehead and upon the hand = in primes and in ultimates; and the prime and the ultimate = all things.
The hands = power, and thence all ability with man.
To wash the hands and the feet = to purify the natural man.
That the Lord glorified His Human even to its ultimate... He manifested by His having showed His hands and His feet... by the hands and the feet are signified the ultimates of man. AE 619:15.
To place the hands upon the head () = that there was not any intelligence.
That the works of the hands = such things as man thinks, wills, and does from proprium. Illustrated.
The works of the hands, when attributed to Jehovah, = man reformed or regenerated; also the Church; and, in special, the doctrine of truth and good. Illustrated.
The right hand = all that which is of the will, and thence of the affection.
To eat the labour of his hands = the celestial good which man receives from the Lord through a life according to Divine truths; and acquires as it were by his own labour and study.
To enter into the hand, and pierce it = to destroy all intellectual power, and to see and seize on mere falsities for truths.
The hand = the Omnipotence of truth from good; and the arm, the Omnipotence of good through truth.
He who hangs down his hands, and awaits influx, receives nothing.
To take hold of the hand and guard () = from Divine Omnipotence which the Hells cannot resist.
They who act against these things from purpose, which is meant by to do with a high hand ().

To stretch out the hands () = not to be in that freedom; for the hands = the power of truth from the understanding and perception of it; and to stretch out the hands = not to have this power; and therefore neither the power of thinking and seeing truth.
Hence it is that by the Angels of the Third Heaven the quality of a man is known... from the touch of his hand, etc.
To receive the mark upon the hand () = to acknowledge the falsities of that faith as truths of the Church; for the hands are said of truths.
They who hang down their hands, awaiting influx... remain in the state of their evil; and hang down their hands to eternity.
